plan.scope: 24 synthetic scenarios from the existing 100, not 24 real participants
change_log: Original seed and its IDs/query strings are preserved verbatim in 01_original_seed_data.json.
Original documentation said 12 priority cases; actual seed contains 13, all Budget-conscious.
Original 25 held_out cases all have Location convenience. This new pre-measurement plan replaces only the experiment assignment, not source personas.
New 24-case MVP: 12 development and 12 validation-holdout. Each half has three of each of the four constraints; all five segments/intents appear two or three times.
This is designed coverage, not a representative market sample. Do not report population choice or conversion estimates.
If original experiments were already run elsewhere, do not relabel them. Keep their original plan/version and use this plan only for new runs.
plan.repeat_rule: Each repeat uses a new unpersonalized, non-project chat with the exact original query. Repeats measure variability; they are not independent customers.
plan.validation_rule: Keep validation scenarios/results out of optimization prompts. Freeze evaluation rules and assets before final validation; after inspecting validation, a further optimization loop requires a new validation set.
plan.platform_rule: Use one platform/model setting per comparison; record visible model label or null with reason, account/session configuration, language, location context and source mode. Model backend version and search index cannot be fully controlled.
plan.location_rule: Queries explicitly name Pacific Beach, San Diego. Tester location may differ from a real San Diego diner; disclose this limit.
plan.live_vs_simulation_rule: Live search, controlled simulation and source audits stay in separate datasets. A source audit is not a search recommendation observation.
plan.retest_rule: Rerun exact prompts; store new run IDs, never overwrite baseline. Live retest is permitted without publication as a repeatability control; do not call its delta an effect of the unpublished draft. Controlled retest changes only target content, preserving candidates, evidence scope and rubric.
plan.rank_rule: Record textual mention, recommendation and display position separately. Numbered list order is not necessarily an explicit preference rank. Unknown or unranked rank = null.

change_log: Original seed and its IDs/query strings are preserved verbatim in 01_original_seed_data.json.
Original documentation said 12 priority cases; actual seed contains 13, all Budget-conscious.
Original 25 held_out cases all have Location convenience. This new pre-measurement plan replaces only the experiment assignment, not source personas.
New 24-case MVP: 12 development and 12 validation-holdout. Each half has three of each of the four constraints; all five segments/intents appear two or three times.
This is designed coverage, not a representative market sample. Do not report population choice or conversion estimates.
If original experiments were already run elsewhere, do not relabel them. Keep their original plan/version and use this plan only for new runs.
plan.repeat_rule: Each repeat uses a new unpersonalized, non-project chat with the exact original query. Repeats measure variability; they are not independent customers.
plan.validation_rule: Keep validation scenarios/results out of optimization prompts. Freeze evaluation rules and assets before final validation; after inspecting validation, a further optimization loop requires a new validation set.
plan.platform_rule: Use one platform/model setting per comparison; record visible model label or null with reason, account/session configuration, language, location context and source mode. Model backend version and search index cannot be fully controlled.
plan.location_rule: Queries explicitly name Pacific Beach, San Diego. Tester location may differ from a real San Diego diner; disclose this limit.
plan.live_vs_simulation_rule: Live search, controlled simulation and source audits stay in separate datasets. A source audit is not a search recommendation observation.
plan.retest_rule: Rerun exact prompts; store new run IDs, never overwrite baseline. Live retest is permitted without publication as a repeatability control; do not call its delta an effect of the unpublished draft. Controlled retest changes only target content, preserving candidates, evidence scope and rubric.
plan.rank_rule: Record textual mention, recommendation and display position separately. Numbered list order is not necessarily an explicit preference rank. Unknown or unranked rank = null.
